decisions.reason: Locates inject/apiProxy.llm.providers (index.js:3,9) and flags the apiproxy dependency pin, but maps only 'by surface' without A1-01 and never explains the llm injection/listProviders replacement or that the dependency is dead (removed), only 'unverified'.

Each of the other six categories is covered with per-file grep evidence; session-notes.js correctly cleared as a pure utility decoy; cordis.patch.yml treated as ordinary composition/manifest, not a host-source patch; no coupling invented from filenames.

Explains zero-hit is absence-of-evidence, that dependency/config/runtime need separate evidence (RC pin invisible to code scan), and clearly separates the one decisive apiProxy break from the six negatives.
Proposes post-migration build/typecheck, isolated-profile cold boot exercising apply/injection without error, and an actual provider-listing call; framed as proposed checks, not executed ones.
